transition_policy.allowed_match_semantics: A transition matches only when its from value equals the current state or its from array explicitly contains the current state. Wildcards are forbidden in allowed transitions.
transition_policy.terminal_semantics: A terminal state has no outgoing allowed transition. Reversible or recurring stable states must not be declared terminal.
transition_policy.refusal_precedence: If no allowed transition and guard match exactly, refuse even when a UI proposes the destination.
